subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88841's close-handler re-arm mitigation for this issue, or require a public lifecycle root-cause reproduction before any fix lands?
rationale: The issue now has fresh live failure evidence and the PR has live after-fix proof, but current source review still has not identified the public transition that clears reconnect on an active socket.

options.title: Repair and review the candidate PR
options.body: Promote the diagnostic/logging gap if still needed, then decide whether the close-handler mitigation plus live proof is acceptable for this issue.

options.title: Require root-cause reproduction first
options.body: Keep both items open until a public lifecycle transition reproduces the stale reconnect-disabled state and the fix moves to that owner path.

options.title: Add only an operator reconnect fallback
options.body: Treat automatic recovery as unresolved and instead pursue a channel-scoped reconnect action as a temporary recovery surface.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Promote the diagnostic/logging gap if still needed, then decide whether the close-handler mitigation plus live proof is acceptable for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle provided the maintainer objection on the candidate PR and has recent history in the same Discord reconnect/lifecycle files.
